council: St Albans City and District Council
current_date: 2023 (page link titles, e.g. 'Validation Checklist - Householder 2023'; the Major checklist text itself is undated. A council news release says the revised Local Validation Lists, consulted on 1 Aug-26 Sep [2022], were due to operate from November)
current_evidence: The council's 'Application forms and validation checklists' page still links the 2023 set of type-specific checklists, including this Major checklist. No later list or consultation was found on stalbans.gov.uk; the latest validation-list consultation found was the Aug-Sep 2022 review.

issues.detail: The workbook URL points to just one checklist (Full planning permission, Major). St Albans' local list is a set of about 25 application-type checklists on the 'Application forms and validation checklists' page, so that page should be the reference link. The Major checklist is current, but on its own it does not cover householder, minor, LBC and other types.
issues.evidence: The checklists page lists 20 checklists in the 2023 folder plus the HCC Major surface water proforma and 2017 Tree Works, Hedgerow and Full+LBC checklists.

issues.detail: The list date 2023-03-01 comes from PDF metadata; the checklist text has no date. The page labels the checklists '2023' (Demolition in a CA '2022'), and the council's consultation news release says the revised lists were to operate from November 2022. Several checklists still in use are dated June 2017 (Full planning + LBC, Tree Works, Hedgerow Removal Notice). Grokbot used the 2017 Full+LBC checklist for its Full planning HRA and Highways rows.
issues.evidence: News release (stalbans.gov.uk/node/10032): consultation 1 August-26 September, 'new Lists ... due to become operational in November'.

issues.detail: Requirements in the Major checklist that have no row of their own: Construction Environment Management Plan (all major developments); Climate Change Statement (added for majors in the 2022 review); Recycling/Waste Strategy (any new mixed-use development, any major development, any apartment blocks); Landscape Strategy (all major developments; Grokbot has only a garbled 'Landscaping scheme' row); Agricultural Land Survey (loss of agricultural land, folded into the Air Quality row); Neighbourhood Plan requirements for major applications in the Harpenden, Sandridge and St Stephen parish areas (Sustainability Statement, Dwelling Mix Statement, Public Open Space Provision Statement, Design Brief, Utilities and Infrastructure Statement, CO2 Emissions Statement, Healthcare Provision Statement, Retail and Employment Statement; only URL fragments in tab_items); Surface Water Drainage Statement (HCC major proforma linked from the page).
issues.evidence: Major checklist: 'Construction Environment Management Plan - Required for all major developments'; 'Landscape Strategy - Required for all major developments'.

issues.detail: Checklists on the page that were not captured. The Tree Works Validation Checklist (June 2017) exists, but Works to trees shows '(none)'. The Larger Home Extension 2023 checklist was not read. The Hedgerow Removal Notice checklist was read but produced no rows. The separate 'Planning Permission and Advertising Consent' checklist was not read.
issues.evidence: Checklists page links 'Tree Works Validation Checklist June 2017' and 'Validation Checklist - Larger Home Extension 2023'.

issues.detail: Major and Full planning triggers are widely garbled by two-column PDF interleaving, and many belong to other requirements. Affordable Housing Statement ('Normally required when there is a change in height...', the street-scene text) should be 'applications providing 15 or more new residential units'. Planning Statement ('any new mixed use development, any major development and any development involving blocks of apartments', the Recycling/Waste trigger) should be 10+ dwellings (or 0.5ha), 1,000m2+ floorspace or sites of 1ha+. Fire Statement (FRA/BRE daylight text) should be buildings with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation at 18m+ or 7+ storeys. Noise Impact Assessment (parking-standards text) should be housing near noisy environments, noisy uses near housing, or new plant such as air source heat pumps. Structural Survey and Contaminated Land share one merged excerpt.
issues.evidence: Major checklist: Affordable Housing Statement 'Required for applications providing 15 or more new residential units'.

issues.detail: Householder and Listed building consent triggers are swapped between items. 'Flood Risk Assessment' has the shadow-diagram text from Daylight/Sunlight. 'Heritage Statement' has the FRA sequential-test text. 'Sequential / Exception Test' has the heritage-asset text. 'Structural Survey' has the tree-survey trigger ('There are significant trees within the site...'). 'Biodiversity' has archaeological-evaluation text. 'Archaeological Assessment' has 'All submitted plans and drawings must have written dimensions'. In Outline, 'Transport Assessment' has structural-survey and floor-plan text and 'Affordable Housing Statement' has scale-bar text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot Householder FRA trigger: 'Flood Risk Assessment Should include diagrams of how the shadows of the building will impact on neighbours for all four quarters of the year.'

issues.detail: Reserved matters is '(none)' although Grokbot read the 'Reserved Matters 2023' checklist. Six rows sourced from that checklist (Affordable Housing Statement, Design and Access Statement, Sequential/Exception Test, Statement of Community Involvement, Travel Plan, Viability Assessment) were put under Full planning as 'INFERRED'. Twenty-nine rows in total are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', mostly from the Major checklist, which is a full planning (major) list, so those placements are reasonable. The Reserved Matters ones are not.
issues.evidence: Rows under Full planning with source '...Validation%20Checklist%20-%20Reserved%20Matters%202023.pdf' and notes 'INFERRED'. The Reserved matters row reads '(none)'.

issues.detail: Rows from the Prior Notification for Demolition, Prior Notification for Agricultural Building and Prior Notification for Telecoms checklists are filed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. None of these is a change-of-use prior approval. A 'Schedule of works (listed building)' row was also created from the demolition prior notification's Demolition Method Statement text. Under Lawful development cert, items from the 'LDC for proposed works to a Listed Building' checklist (schedule of works, 1:10/1:20 details) are applied to all LDCs.
issues.evidence: Change of use row 'Schedule of works (listed building)' sourced from 'Validation Checklist - Prior Notification for Demolition 2023.pdf'.

issues.detail: The 24 Listed building consent rows are near-exact copies of the 24 Householder rows. Both come from the combined 'Householder and Listed Building Consent 2023' checklist instead of the standalone 'Householder 2023' and 'Listed Building Consent 2023' checklists (only the Roof plan rows cite those). As a result, Householder carries LBC-only items (schedule of works, method statements, lime mortar specs), and both carry a Green Belt-only Planning Statement trigger.
issues.evidence: Householder and LBC rows share the same source ('Validation Checklist- Householder and Listed Building Consent 2023.pdf') and identical trigger text.

issues.detail: Some app rows are not requirements. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' (trigger '(2021) regarding pre-application engagement.') appears under every application type, but it is NPPF encouragement, not a validation requirement. 'Validation checklist form (completed)' is checklist header boilerplate. 'Design Code / Masterplan / Parameter plans' with trigger 'National Model Design Code (S5)' is a policy reference shown under Householder and LBC.
issues.evidence: Major checklist only 'encourages early engagement under NPPF paragraphs 39-42' and offers a pre-application service.

issues.detail: Many tab_items are not requirements. The 17 'Local forms / checklists' items are checklist titles plus the boilerplate 'The following information ... must be submitted'. The 'Submission rules' items are process or fee text: Privacy Notice, invalid application charge from 1 Sept 2020, publication of statements, hard copies not kept, and two sensitive personal data notices. There are also garbled neighbourhood-plan URL fragments ('Protecting River Ver and Colne (S9) St Stephen Parish Neighbourhood Plan ans.gov.uk/sites/...'), a planning-fee URL fragment filed under Drawing standards, and 'Affordable Housing Statement Contain a scale bar...'.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'From 1 September 2020, if an application is made that fails to meet our validation requirements, an invalid application charge will be made.'

issues.detail: The BNG requirement taken from the checklists page appears only under Full planning. The page says it applies to 'All major and minor developments, with some exceptions', so it should also cover Outline (and Householder is exempt nationally).
issues.evidence: Checklists page: 'All major and minor developments, with some exceptions, are now required to provide a Biodiversity Net Gain of 10%.'

summary: The workbook link works and the 2023 checklists are still current. But it links only the Major full-planning checklist instead of the checklists page that holds the whole local list, and the date comes from PDF metadata. The extraction has many garbled or swapped triggers, misses major-only items (CEMP, Climate Change Statement, Waste Strategy, Landscape Strategy, Neighbourhood Plan statements), copies Householder rows into LBC, and leaves Reserved matters and Works to trees empty despite checklists existing for them.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
